## Immutable text

Strings are immutable sequences of Unicode. Slicing (`s[1:4]`), `split`, `join`, `strip`, and `replace` cover most work.

## f-strings

The modern way to format: `f"Hi {name}, total {total:.2f}"`. They also support `=` for debugging: `f"{x=}"`.

## Bytes vs str

`str` is text; `bytes` is raw data. Encode/decode explicitly with UTF-8 at I/O boundaries.

blocks.code:
name, total = "Ada", 19.5
print(f"Hi {name}, total ${total:.2f}")
print(f"{total=}")  # total=19.5
